articleTitle: Expensya Homepage Teardown: Oct 2020 to Jun 2026
h1: How Expensya rewrote its homepage over 6 years

analysis-blocks.label: Oct 2020 — original state
analysis-blocks.heading: The original: product-led messaging
annotations: H1 opens with: "Automated spend management for all companies" — direct product statement.

Visible section headings include: "Equip yourself with the most comprehensive business spend and expense management solution, tailored to your needs and to those of your teams", "Expensya fully automates your business expenditure", "A solution designed for every company".

Section headings later removed include: "Equip yourself with the most comprehensive business spend and expense management solution, tailored to your needs and to those of your teams" and "Expensya fully automates your business expenditure".

analysis-blocks.label: Jun 2026 — current state
analysis-blocks.heading: Today: updated positioning
annotations: H1 now reads: "Voici à quoi devrait ressembler la gestion des dépenses." — updated value proposition.
New section headings include: "Améliorez la conformité. Réduisez les risques. Obtenez une visibilité complète sur les dépenses.", "Cartes de paiement & budgets", "Politiques de dépenses".
CTAs no longer present include: "Free trial", "Discover our solutions", "Find out more".

messaging.before: Automated spend management for all companies
messaging.after: Voici à quoi devrait ressembler la gestion des dépenses.
messaging.note: This change can be read as a deliberate update to the primary value proposition frame. No confirmed strategy is implied.

messaging.before: From paperless invoices to reimbursement, Expensya software and mobile app automate every step of the spend management and expense reporting process.
messaging.after: Remplacez le stress et les frictions liés à la gestion des dépenses et des notes de frais des employés par la clarté et la simplicité : voici Expensya, le logiciel intelligent de gestion des dépenses pour les équipes financières modernes.
messaging.note: Meta description updated. The change in framing may reflect a positioning adjustment or an SEO update.

messaging.before: Automated spend management for all companies
messaging.after: Gestion des dépenses des employés et cartes de paiement | Expensya

snapshots.above_fold_structure: Large headline with subtext, isometric product illustration on right, green CTA button and secondary link below
Hero section with female portrait image on right side, French headline text overlay, blue CTA button prominently positioned

visual-analysis.visual_shift_summary: The design shifted from an isometric illustration-led approach with centered layout to a full-bleed photography-driven hero featuring a real person, moving from abstract product visualization to human-centric narrative storytelling.
